title: Far and Near
introduction: ‘Far and Near’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects length, distance, measurement units, comparison, estimation. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
